notablePrerequisites:
You control a blue and a black permanent.
Thornbite Staff attached to Faeburrow Elder.
Faeburrow Elder does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Faeburrow Elder by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Worldheart Phoenix, adding {C}{C}.
Worldheart Phoenix dies, triggering Faeburrow Elder, untapping Faeburrow Elder.
Cast Worldheart Phoenix from your graveyard by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Repeat.
